en.greeting: Hi! Today we go into town. You'll learn the names of places, how to say how you travel, and how to follow simple directions.

steps.title: Places in town
steps.text: Let's start with the places you see every day in town.
steps.body: Many names **flip** the Indonesian order: kantor pos = **post office**, pom bensin = **petrol station**. In English the main word (office, station) comes **last**. **Station** alone usually means the train station; a **bus stop** is the halte on the street. Rumah sakit is one word: **hospital**. British vs American: petrol station (UK) = gas station (US).

steps.title: Places in sentences
steps.text: Now use the places with words you already know: there's, next to, between, behind.
steps.body: **Near** = dekat. *Is there a … near here?* = Apakah ada … di dekat sini?

examples.en: There's a bank next to the station.
examples.id: Ada bank di sebelah stasiun.

examples.en: The pharmacy is between the market and the mosque.
examples.id: Apoteknya di antara pasar dan masjid.

examples.en: My sister is a nurse at the hospital.
examples.id: Kakak perempuan saya perawat di rumah sakit.

examples.en: Is there a bus stop near here?
examples.id: Apakah ada halte bus di dekat sini?

examples.en: The police station is behind the park.
examples.id: Kantor polisinya di belakang taman.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.text: Where does Dewi go?

options: At the post office.
At the pharmacy.
At the petrol station.
question.prompt: Dewi has a headache. She needs some medicine. Where can she buy it?
question.explanation: You buy medicine (obat) at the **pharmacy** (apotek). The **post office** is for letters and parcels, the **petrol station** for petrol (bensin).

steps.title: How do you travel?
steps.text: Now let's talk about how you get there.
steps.body: Naik bus = **by bus**: use **by** + the transport, with no a or the. Not 'with bus': *with* is for a person you're with (*with my friend*). Walking is the exception: jalan kaki = **on foot** (not 'by foot'), or just *I walk*. Pulang = **go home**, with no 'to'. British vs American: motorbike (UK) = motorcycle (US).

steps.title: Your turn
steps.text: Pak Hasan takes the KRL every morning.

options: with train
by the train
by train
question.prompt: Pak Hasan lives in Bogor and works in Jakarta. Every day he goes to work ___.
question.explanation: Naik kereta = **by train**: **by** + the transport, with no a or the. 'With train' is a word-for-word translation of 'naik', and 'by the train' adds an extra word.

steps.title: Build the sentence
steps.text: Now say how you get home.

question.prompt: Arrange the words: Kami pulang naik taksi.
question.explanation: Pulang = **go home**, with no 'to' before home. Then say how: **by taxi**. Order: who (**We**) + **go home** + **by taxi**.

steps.title: Left, right, straight on
steps.text: Now the words for directions.
steps.body: Directions start with the action word, like *Open your book* in class: **Go straight on**, **Turn left**. Say **turn left**, not 'turn to left'. **Turn left** is what you do (belok); **on the left** is where the place is (letaknya). Lampu merah = **traffic lights** (all the lights), not 'red light'. British vs American: go straight on (UK) = go straight / go straight ahead (US).

steps.title: Your turn
steps.text: A man asks you the way to the mosque.

options: Go straight on and turn left.
Go straight on and turn to left.
Go straight on and turn the left.
question.explanation: It's **turn left**, with no little word in the middle: not 'turn to left' (a word-for-word 'belok ke kiri') and not 'turn the left'.

steps.title: Asking the way
steps.text: Here's how people ask the way and answer. Read them out loud.
steps.body: Start with **Excuse me** (permisi). The answer has two parts: **how to go** (Go straight on…) and **where it is** (It's on the right…). Too fast? Say *Sorry, can you repeat that, please?*

examples.en: Excuse me, where's the post office?
examples.id: Permisi, kantor posnya di mana?

examples.en: Excuse me, is there a pharmacy near here?
examples.id: Permisi, apakah ada apotek di dekat sini?

examples.en: Go straight on to the traffic lights.
examples.id: Jalan lurus terus sampai lampu merah.

examples.en: Cross the road at the corner.
examples.id: Menyeberanglah di tikungan.

examples.en: It's on the right, next to the bank.
examples.id: Letaknya di sebelah kanan, di samping bank.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: Ask the way to the station. Press play and listen to the answer.

question.listen: Turn right at the corner. The station is on your left, next to the market.
options: On your right, next to the market.
On your left, next to the market.
On your left, next to the bank.
question.explanation: You hear **turn right** (what you do), then **The station is on your left, next to the market** (where it is). Don't mix the turn with the place.

steps.title: Cheat sheet
steps.text: Here's everything on one page. Keep it for your next trip into town.

tips: The order flips: kantor pos = **post office**, pom bensin = **petrol station**.
Naik bus = **by bus** (not `with bus`, no a/the). Jalan kaki = **on foot** (not `by foot`). Pulang = **go home**.

steps.title: Learn more
steps.text: Want more practice? Try these exercises on places, transport and directions.

id.greeting: Hai! Hari ini kita jalan-jalan ke kota. Kamu akan belajar nama-nama tempat, cara bilang naik apa, dan cara mengikuti petunjuk arah sederhana.

steps.title: Tempat di kota
steps.text: Kita mulai dari tempat-tempat yang kamu lihat setiap hari di kota.
steps.body: Banyak nama tempat urutannya **terbalik** dari bahasa Indonesia: kantor pos = **post office**, pom bensin = **petrol station**. Di bahasa Inggris kata utamanya (office, station) ada di **belakang**. **Station** saja biasanya berarti stasiun kereta; **bus stop** adalah halte di pinggir jalan. Rumah sakit cukup satu kata: **hospital**. Inggris (UK) vs Amerika (US): petrol station (UK) = gas station (US).

steps.title: Tempat dalam kalimat
steps.text: Sekarang pakai nama tempat dengan kata yang sudah kamu tahu: there's, next to, between, behind.
steps.body: **Near** = dekat. *Is there a … near here?* = Apakah ada … di dekat sini?

examples.en: There's a bank next to the station.
examples.id: Ada bank di sebelah stasiun.

examples.en: The pharmacy is between the market and the mosque.
examples.id: Apoteknya di antara pasar dan masjid.

examples.en: My sister is a nurse at the hospital.
examples.id: Kakak perempuan saya perawat di rumah sakit.

examples.en: Is there a bus stop near here?
examples.id: Apakah ada halte bus di dekat sini?

examples.en: The police station is behind the park.
examples.id: Kantor polisinya di belakang taman.

steps.title: Giliranmu
steps.text: Dewi pergi ke mana?

options: At the post office.
At the pharmacy.
At the petrol station.
question.prompt: Dewi sakit kepala dan perlu obat. Di mana dia bisa membelinya?
question.explanation: Obat (medicine) dibeli di **pharmacy** (apotek). **Post office** untuk surat dan paket, **petrol station** untuk bensin.

steps.title: Kamu naik apa?
steps.text: Sekarang kita bahas cara ke sana.
steps.body: Naik bus = **by bus**: pakai **by** + kendaraannya, tanpa a atau the. Bukan 'with bus': *with* untuk orang yang bersamamu (*with my friend*). Jalan kaki itu pengecualian: **on foot** (bukan 'by foot'), atau cukup *I walk*. Pulang = **go home**, tanpa 'to'. Inggris (UK) vs Amerika (US): motorbike (UK) = motorcycle (US).

steps.title: Giliranmu
steps.text: Pak Hasan naik KRL setiap pagi.

options: with train
by the train
by train
question.prompt: Pak Hasan tinggal di Bogor dan bekerja di Jakarta. Lengkapi: Every day he goes to work ___.
question.explanation: Naik kereta = **by train**: **by** + kendaraannya, tanpa a atau the. 'With train' adalah terjemahan kata per kata dari 'naik', dan 'by the train' menambah kata yang tidak perlu.

steps.title: Susun kalimatnya
steps.text: Sekarang katakan cara kamu pulang.

question.prompt: Susun kata-katanya: Kami pulang naik taksi.
question.explanation: Pulang = **go home**, tanpa 'to' sebelum home. Lalu sebutkan naik apa: **by taxi**. Urutannya: siapa (**We**) + **go home** + **by taxi**.

steps.title: Kiri, kanan, lurus
steps.text: Sekarang kata-kata untuk petunjuk arah.
steps.body: Petunjuk arah diawali kata tindakan, seperti *Open your book* di kelas: **Go straight on**, **Turn left**. Katakan **turn left**, bukan 'turn to left'. **Turn left** = yang kamu lakukan (belok); **on the left** = letak tempatnya. Lampu merah = **traffic lights** (semua lampunya), bukan 'red light'. Inggris (UK) vs Amerika (US): go straight on (UK) = go straight / go straight ahead (US).

steps.title: Giliranmu
steps.text: Seorang bapak menanyakan jalan ke masjid.

options: Go straight on and turn left.
Go straight on and turn to left.
Go straight on and turn the left.
question.explanation: Yang benar **turn left**, tanpa kata kecil di tengah: bukan 'turn to left' (terjemahan kata per kata 'belok ke kiri') dan bukan 'turn the left'.

steps.title: Menanyakan jalan
steps.text: Begini cara orang menanyakan jalan dan menjawabnya. Baca dengan suara keras.
steps.body: Mulai dengan **Excuse me** (permisi). Jawabannya punya dua bagian: **cara ke sana** (Go straight on…) dan **letaknya** (It's on the right…). Terlalu cepat? Katakan *Sorry, can you repeat that, please?*

examples.en: Excuse me, where's the post office?
examples.id: Permisi, kantor posnya di mana?

examples.en: Excuse me, is there a pharmacy near here?
examples.id: Permisi, apakah ada apotek di dekat sini?

examples.en: Go straight on to the traffic lights.
examples.id: Jalan lurus terus sampai lampu merah.

examples.en: Cross the road at the corner.
examples.id: Menyeberanglah di tikungan.

examples.en: It's on the right, next to the bank.
examples.id: Letaknya di sebelah kanan, di samping bank.

steps.title: Dengarkan
steps.text: Kamu menanyakan jalan ke stasiun. Tekan play dan dengarkan jawabannya.

question.listen: Turn right at the corner. The station is on your left, next to the market.
options: On your right, next to the market.
On your left, next to the market.
On your left, next to the bank.
question.explanation: Kamu mendengar **turn right** (yang kamu lakukan), lalu **The station is on your left, next to the market** (letaknya). Jangan campur arah belok dengan letak tempatnya.
